name: OmniPulse XR: Way to Fitness
summary:
Step into the ultimate VR boxing experience blending high-intensity gaming with authentic athletic conditioning. Perfect your striking form, torch calories, and sharpen your precision.

* **75+ Structured Workouts:** Choose from a growing library of 75+ unique routines with varying difficulty and duration, with more updates to come.
* **Rhythm & Mood:** High-energy music tracks with driving beats are paired with every section to encourage natural striking rhythms and elevate your mood.
